ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Rundll32 Execution With Image Extension
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of Rundll32.exe with DLL files masquerading as image files

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bmp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cr2.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.eps.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.gif.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ico.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jpeg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jpg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.nef.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.orf.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.png.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.raw.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.sr2.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.tif.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.tiff.*")))
